scope: 82 goals each, existing canonical maps and fixed targets reused byte-for-byte; no Gazebo/controller started

rationale.hybrid: Reeds-Shepp preserves forward/reverse; radius0.1m matches new Lattice metadata. 72 heading bins and analytic expansions are native Hybrid settings, not Lattice primitives.
rationale.theta: w_traversal_cost5 preserved from successful recent Theta experiment.
rationale.smac2d: Cost multiplier2. On installed Nav2 1.1.20 Smac2D has no smooth_path flag; smoother.max_iterations=0 disables native smoother. Initial unsupported flag was caught before sending any planning goal, then corrected.
rationale.goal_handling: Native positional/heading discretization differs. Theta has no tolerance parameter; exact requested endpoint is evaluated separately. No common fake timeout or physical feasibility guarantee.
